name: Champaubert
summary: The first of the Six Days: marching north through the mud, Napoleon fell on Olsufiev's isolated Russian corps strung out along Blücher's line of march, and destroyed it; Olsufiev was taken.

sources.label: Six Days' Campaign order of battle (Wikipedia)

toCome.name: Marmont's Corps
toCome.formation: Lagrange's 3rd and Ricard's 8th Divisions, VI Corps
toCome.summary: Led the march over the Petit Morin at Saint-Prix: Lagrange's division, Pelleport's brigade leading, took Bannay, and Ricard's took Baye and then fought for Champaubert itself.

toCome.name: Ney's Young Guard
toCome.formation: Meunier's 1st and Curial's 2nd Young Guard Divisions
toCome.summary: Came up while the fight went on, and their guns joined the bombardment of Bannay.

toCome.name: Doumerc's and Bordesoulle's Cavalry
toCome.summary: Bordesoulle's cuirassiers rode round the Russian right and split Olsufiev's corps in two, while Doumerc's horse went round its left and closed the road at Fromentières.

toCome.name: Olsufiev's Corps
toCome.formation: Udom's 9th and Kornilov's 15th Divisions, IX Infantry Corps, Army of Silesia
toCome.summary: About four thousand men and twenty-four guns, strung out along Blücher's line of march. Most were killed or taken, Olsufiev and Poltoratsky among them; Kornilov brought some fifteen hundred away through the woods.
